//! Writes a database whose snapshot holds two tables naming a column after
//! the row identity, both renamed since
use stoolap::Database;

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("an output directory");
    let db = Database::open(&format!("file://{out}/snapshot_named_rowid_twice")).unwrap();
    for table in ["t", "t2"] {
        db.execute(&format!("CREATE TABLE {table} (a INTEGER, _rowid_ INTEGER)"), ())
            .unwrap();
        db.execute(&format!("INSERT INTO {table} VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20)"), ())
            .unwrap();
    }
    db.execute("PRAGMA SNAPSHOT", ()).unwrap();
    for table in ["t", "t2"] {
        db.execute(&format!("ALTER TABLE {table} RENAME COLUMN _rowid_ TO b"), ())
            .unwrap();
    }
    db.close().unwrap();
}
